entries.name: Agent Sandbox (Flash Edition)
entries.purpose: Managed E2B-compatible sandboxes for agent code, browser and desktop tasks, created by API; no cluster.
entries.useWhen: Default sandbox for agents that run untrusted code or browsers and are not on Kubernetes; teams moving from E2B.
entries.avoidWhen: Customers already on ACK or ACS who want pod-based sandboxes (use acs-agent-sandbox), or GPU work.
entries.note: Flash edition of Agent Sandbox: API-first and E2B-compatible, the default for code that is not on Kubernetes. GA since 2026-09-21 with self-service activation, available in Singapore. CPU and memory only, no GPU. Code, browser and desktop sandbox types ship; mobile is announced, not shipped; per-type availability per region is set in the console, so confirm browser and desktop there before a proposal. Same service the Function Compute docs call FC Agent Sandbox (inferred; Flash needs Function Compute). The Desktop template must be built once; snapshots and AgenticFS volumes are invite-only. Container edition on ACS is acs-agent-sandbox. No official reference pairs it with PAI-DLC for agentic RL; that is a custom design.
intents: managed E2B-compatible agent sandbox
sandbox for an agent to run code or browse

entries.name: Agent Sandbox Container Edition (ACS)
entries.purpose: VM-isolated agent sandboxes as pods in your ACS cluster, with warm pools, hibernation and E2B API.
entries.useWhen: Customers already on ACK or ACS who want many agent or RL-rollout sandboxes with warm pools and multi-tenancy.
entries.avoidWhen: No Kubernetes in the picture (use agent-sandbox), or GPU work inside the sandbox (none).
entries.note: Container edition of Agent Sandbox, for customers already on ACK or ACS; driven by the SandboxSet, SandboxClaim and SandboxTemplate CRDs. GA since 2026-09-21 with self-service activation, available in Singapore. The ACS user-guide page still shows a stale public-preview banner (2026-06-23): cite the standalone Agent Sandbox docs. CPU and memory only, no GPU. Code, browser and desktop sandbox types ship; mobile is announced, not shipped; per-type availability per region is set in the console, so confirm browser and desktop there before a proposal. Needs Agent Sandbox activated on an ACS cluster, the controller and sandbox-manager add-ons, and an Ingress (ALB) with a domain and TLS. Default creation quota is low (burst 100, then 20 per minute): request more for RL fleets.
